I then checked "defensive wall", "volley", "offside", and "bicycle kick". The board started to behave like one phrase pattern across Wall, Volley, Offside, Yellow card, and Bicycle kick.

That left very little room for the earlier false start. The answer was "Terms associated with football", and the last step was simply making sure every clue used that same reading cleanly before treating the solve as finished.
